character.description: Short sturdy Vietnamese vegetable auntie with checked floral headscarf, pale green floral blouse, moss-green apron, cropped trousers, sandals, mischievous smile and small tooth gap.

chroma_key.name: cyan
chroma_key.selection_reason: highest 1st-percentile subject distance among the 4 candidate(s) clearing the 96 erase radius

idle.action: Quiet standing idle only. Use the exact same relaxed, cute, slightly funny forward-facing pose and expression in all frames. Keep both feet on the same ground line. Only a tiny, slow whole-body vertical bob: baseline, 2 px up, 4 px up, 2 px up, then loop. No wave, blink, eye glance, head tilt, arm gesture, prop action, pose change, or exaggerated bounce.

style: Keep the exact established vendor design. Cute, gently humorous Vietnamese mobile-game cartoon NPC like the supplied in-game reference: compact body, readable friendly face with one mild quirky detail, bold dark outline, simple matte hand-painted colors and restrained shading. No glossy 3D finish, no extra playful acting, no change in outfit, proportions, palette or silhouette.
